title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Record Mirror | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono were interviewed by Mike Hennessey of Record Mirror on 3 August 1971.

The interview took place on the couple’s bed. During the exchange, Lennon went through a list of Beatles songs and discussed who wrote each song. They were also photographed by Tony Hanley for the feature in and around Tittenhurst Park.
